facts.statement: The annual Heart Festival started in Joyful Valley and celebrates the legend of the pixies Valentin and Arianna, whose special sunflower-like flower still blooms.
facts.quote: Le Festival annuel des Cœurs a commencé dans la Vallée Joyeuse.

facts.statement: During the festival there is a wheel available every day that lets players win prizes.
facts.quote: Tous les jours, il y a une roue qui te permettra de gagner des prix

facts.statement: Festival activities include daily quests, members-only quests, card packs, new pets, Station Cash and coin-shop items, and outfits such as the King and Queen of Hearts outfits.
facts.quote: des quêtes journalières, des quêtes réservées uniquement aux membres, des paquets de JCC, nouveaux animaux

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Le Festival des Cœurs vient de commencer)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news post announcing the annual Heart Festival (Festival des Cœurs) in Joyful Valley, which is said to have started about 1 year 3 months before the 2011-06-04 capture (so roughly early 2010; the exact date is not in the text). It lists festival activities (a daily prize wheel, daily quests, members-only quests, trading card packs, new pets, Station Cash and coin-shop items, and King and Queen of Hearts outfits) and describes the festival's antagonist, Cœur de Pierre, who appears each year and spoils the festivities. It also says how to reach the festival.
